Data Engineer

Company: DataCorp
Location: Hyderabad

Help us build data pipelines and warehousing solutions.

Requirements:
- 3+ years data engineering experience
- Python programming
- SQL expertise
- ETL/ELT pipeline development
- Apache Spark knowledge
- Data warehouse concepts
- PostgreSQL or similar databases
- Big data technologies

Nice to Have:
- Hadoop experience
- Airflow orchestration
- AWS Glue or Redshift
- Scala programming
- Machine learning pipeline knowledge
